reviews.title: Good quality for such a low price.
reviews.comment: Works as it should.  Noise level is minimal, even at higher speeds.  Even at its "normal" base speed, I can still feel it moving a decent volume of air, so that is a definite plus.  Combined with the five other case fans, I HAVE noticed a temperature/cooling difference.  Felt sturdy right out of the box, especially for the price, so there's that as well.  Easy to use once installed, and cable is long enough to plug in to the CPU pins on the motherboard.  Decent product for price point.  I'd recommend it.
reviews.author: Todd Wolf

reviews.title: High Capability, High Speed, Low Price Fans
reviews.comment:
Great product, no gripes!
NOISE: Out of the box, the RPM curve on these is absurd for a personal/casual setup. You will have to adjust the speeds unless you enjoy sounds akin to a wind turbine. However, if you're putting these in a server, data center, etc. they'll be fine as they come. I rarely expect a product with both customisability and a wide range of it, like this one does, to come out of the box and work perfectly for everyone, so it's not losing any stars for that.
SPEED - As mentioned, you can always adjust fan speeds in your BIOS, or with other software, and these fans have a wide range of speeds. Currently, I have five of these in my gaming/production build running at a stagnant 40% speed, and my system is consistently cool with some faint fan noise. Anything more seems totally overkill, but if you only have a couple of these, you may need higher speeds. Luckily, these are super capable.
CONNECTIVITY - I have these set up in an E-ATX case on both the bottom and top of the case. The cables on these is average in length (clearly intended for ATX cases, the average), so I was limited in how to route the cables. Again, not a big deal, and it's something to expect when building in a bigger case.
At $10 a pop with no complaints worth docking a star for, I am totally satisfied with these fans. Glad I didn't have to spend a fortune to get quality air cooling for my system.
reviews.author: Dave

reviews.title: Great Heatsink Fan Replacement
reviews.comment:
As other reviewers pointed out, the fan does make a sort of "industrial" hum at peak rpms, but the average PC shouldn't need to reach 3000rpm, and you can manually adjust fan levels via bios so this is a non-issue. I bought this fan to replace my old CPU heatsink fan and it works beautifully. The power cable is plenty long enough for what the average person will need.
I tested this fan while playing Cyberpunk 2077 on high/ultra settings for about 30 minutes running around Night City. My CPU temperature stabilized around 68°C at roughly 77% CPU utilization. For normal gaming use, this cooler seems to handle heat very well and keeps temperatures stable. The fan never never needed to go above 1500rpm, and I never heard the fan while playing with headphones.
reviews.author: Ryan

reviews.title: Amazing fans for performance applications
reviews.comment: Amazing quality, and you cant beat the price. Looks great and performs well. Plenty fast and moves a lot of air. Low noise. I would recommend for anyone. The only thing is they have no daisy chain on the cables and the cables are short.
